_comment: How the base model is served in production. The weights are unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B; this file documents the serving configuration so the repository is self-describing.

serving.measured_on: Intel Core i7-1165G7, 4 physical cores, AVX-512, 16 GB RAM

intake.post_check: rule-based verifier over numbers, times, place names and evidence citations
